title: Compact printed editor, common view and read-only preview continuation
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open saved interface
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved working-interface link for the proof run.

manualSteps.label: Desktop preference
manualSteps.instruction: At desktop width, open Workspace Files.

manualSteps.label: Compact navigation
manualSteps.instruction: Resize to480px. Open Files, then close with Escape, Close or clicking the shaded space to the right of Files.

manualSteps.label: Restore
manualSteps.instruction: Resize back to1440px and check the file panel returns.

manualSteps.label: Editor
manualSteps.instruction: At compact width click Open workflow and inspect Diagram and Source.

steps.label: Updated installed workspace
steps.summary: The updated package opens through the normal workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify the owning workspace, not a detached UI route.
steps.actual: Normal Workflows and Files controls are available.

steps.label: Saved engineering interface and desktop navigation
steps.summary: The same exact results render with the desktop file panel open.
steps.purpose: Establish saved identity and desktop preference before compact resizing.
steps.action: Open the saved working link; click Workspace Files if closed.
steps.expected: Exact recorded results and docked navigation.
steps.actual: 20 exact result identities; docked file panel 260px wide.

steps.label: Compact accessibility and editor return
steps.summary: Navigation passes the scoped accessibility scan and Open workflow returns to the existing editor.
steps.purpose: Preserve the complementary editor journey and accessible compact controls.
steps.action: Open Files, scan navigation, close it and click Open workflow.
steps.expected: Zero scoped automated violations and existing editor available.
steps.actual: Navigation has zero WCAG A/AA violations; Diagram, Source and Use saved process remain available.

steps.label: Compact common working view
steps.summary: The common view shows the same exact engineering outputs at the available compact width.
steps.purpose: Prove shared layout applies to the common fallback as well as the saved interface.
steps.action: Open the saved working interface and click Use common working view.
steps.expected: Same exact recorded results; full available width and no outer overflow.
steps.actual: 20 exact common results; document 432px with 432px scroll width.

steps.label: Compact read-only preview
steps.summary: The preview remains a workspace tab, with the same results and accessible Files navigation.
steps.purpose: Verify exact backend read-only scope and compact presentation without compilation or execution.
steps.action: Open the retained preview link; open Files and close with Escape.
steps.expected: Read-only preview of the same UI revision/run and exact results; navigation return works.
steps.actual: Backend read-only binding and 20 exact results verified; preview has the available width and Files returns focus.

steps.label: Entry stopped
steps.summary: The normal workspace entry did not meet the expected state.
steps.action: Stop at the unexpected entry state.
